thread:
alex: Kicking off RC-17 creation now. artifact rc-2026.04-17 (sha: c9d4f22). Can someone eyeball the release notes and the emergency rollback play?
priya: On it. Quick note: our change window is 02:00-04:00 PST tomorrow. Ops-sheriff please ack.
ops-sheriff: I can cover that window. Will be available for 02:00-05:00 PST in case of followups.
dan: Running preflight checks on staging. smoke + integration suites in parallel. ETA ~6m.
deploy-bot: Preflight started: smoke-suite v2.4.1, integ-suite v1.8. Tracking id=preflight-4419876543.
dan: Preflight failed: schema validator error on /v1/embeddings new param "context_hint". Failing tests in embeddings service.
alex: Hmm—PRIYA was going to add that param. Is the client contract updated? We need to decide: (a) remove param, (b) keep and bump client compatibility, (c) gate the param behind a feature flag.
priya: The param is behind opt-in server flag in this RC. Tests failing because staging config didn't enable it. I'll flip the flag and re-run.
deploy-bot: Received config toggle request. Applying flag: embeddings.context_hint.enabled=true to staging.
deploy-bot: Config applied. Re-running preflight.
dan: Re-run green. p95 generation under 220ms. integrations all pass.
kim: Release notes draft: "RC-17: embeddings context_hint opt-in, GPU batching improvements, HA router fixes." Also call out the client compatibility note and migration docs. Draft link: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/rc-17-draft
alex: Rollback plan: revert to rc-16 (artifact rc-2026.03-05 sha: d1a8c3b). Steps: 1) deploybot promote rc-16, 2) run smoke, 3) open incident and tag teams. Approve?
ops-sheriff: Approve. Add step to restore feature flags to rc-16 baseline.
priya: Adding telemetry guard: abort promo if 5xx rate > 0.6% for sustained 3m OR latency p95 > 400ms.
dan: Suggest starting with a smaller canary: 1% for 15m -> 10% 10m -> 50% 10m -> 100%.
alex: Agreed. Pinning artifact now.
alex: ```
# pin command
deploybot pin --artifact rc-2026.04-17 --env prod --by alex --reason "RC-17 origination"
```
deploy-bot: Pin request received. verifying signatures and checksums...
deploy-bot: Artifact verification OK. Artifact pinned to candidate slot.
priya: Note: I'll also push the client migration note to the changelog before promo.
dan: Starting canary: routing 1% to rc-17. deploy-bot, kick it off.
deploy-bot: Promo step started. canary=1% duration=15m tracking_id=promo-4419876543.
5m in: dan: telemetry looks quiet. error rate 0.01%. no redis or DB anomalies.
kim: Observing a small increase in latency on the embeddings route for requests with long context_hint arrays. p95 bumped to 270ms (baseline 180ms).
priya: That's expected for the opt-in param; it's doing extra tokenization. We should see it normalize as caches warm.
ops-sheriff: Standby. If p95 > 350ms sustained 5m, we revert to 0%.
15m passed: dan: canary stable. moving to 10%.
deploy-bot: Updating traffic to 10%.
2m into 10%: dan: small error blip: 0.4% 5xxs for a cluster handling legacy clients. Investigating.
priya: can you dump request logs for that cluster? suspect malformed header from old clients hitting new codepath.
dan: logs show a minority of client versions missing the new header; server currently tolerates but some middleware is erroring. We can either (a) rollback, (b) apply header-strict=false fallback for that cluster, (c) reduce canary.
alex: Do (b) for the problematic cluster and hold canary at 5% while we watch. Priya please enable header fallback.
priya: Toggling header-strict=false for cluster eu-west-1. deploy-bot, config apply.
deploy-bot: Applying config header-strict=false to eu-west-1 on candidate nodes.
1m later: dan: errors drop to 0.06%. good. Can we move to 25%?
alex: Move to 25% but cap duration 10m then evaluate.
deploy-bot: Updating traffic to 25%.
3m into 25%: dan: telem okay, but we see elevated retry rates between service A -> B in some pods. Root cause: a backpressure threshold not tuned for batching changes.
kim: I'll roll a non-disruptive config to increase A->B queue limit on canary. No model change.
\improve: (note: accidental channel noise)
kim: config rolled. queue bump applied.
ops-sheriff: If retry rate doesn't decline within 7m we roll back.
7m later: dan: retries normalized, latency steady. proceed to 100%?
priya: Docs need one more migration note about header fallback behavior. I pushed a small update to the release note.
alex: Any objections?
ops-sheriff: No objections. We'll be monitoring closely.
alex: Final promotion command:```
deploybot promote --artifact rc-2026.04-17 --env prod --staged false --by alex --notes "RC-17 full promo"
```
deploy-bot: Promotion started. moving prod traffic. expected completion ~4m.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Prod routes now serving rc-2026.04-17.
dan: Post-promo smoke: all checks green. Background job backlog cleared as KV warmed.
priya: Publishing release notes and client migration guide. Links: https://git.redwood/release-notes/rc-17 and https://docs.redwood.ai/migration/embeddings-context-hint
ops-sheriff: Staying on call for 90m. rollback trigger: sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 3m OR p95 > 450ms.
alex: Thanks all. Closing thread. If you discover anything odd after we close, open an incident channel and ping ops-sheriff. :rocket:
